_how: The life, from H's 'Life Trajectory v1' (3 Nov 2026). The game reads this file at the start of every life, so edits show up on the next life (no restart).
target: write it the way the player sees it: '3 or more', 'a 6', 'exactly 1'.
scene: what the world shows (painted from the previous world). place (Where cards) is added to every scene after it. wear (Whom cards) dresses the avatar.
chapter: true = a longer breath after this event. tries: throws allowed (Birth = 3). allot: false = a miss allots nothing (Love).
drawn: this event is drawn instead of painted: "egg" (birth.js), "map" (worldmap.js), "house" (house.js), "baby" (baby.js: the baby, then the live kid takes over).

genes (Body cards): what emerges on the baby, one by one. life: true = it stays on the avatar for life (eyes, a birthmark). Skin always comes first and is taken from the player's own camera, never from a card.
pacing: seconds, all minimums. They're also sliders on /panel (PACING), which save back into this file. world.keep: how much of the last world survives into the next (0-1).
phase_refs: optional style reference paintings, one per phase (BASELINE, CRUST, ADULTHOOD, LATER LIFE), e.g. "refs/crust.jpg" in web/refs/. Empty = none.

events.title: Birth
events.setup: Before anything else, the form needs a box ticked.
events.scene: a hospital maternity ward, a small cot under a window, soft morning light

cards.name: Boy
cards.reveals: Sweets are handed out.
cards.scene: a hospital ward, a nurse handing out sweets, blue ribbons

cards.name: Girl
cards.reveals: Sweets are handed out, eventually.
cards.scene: a hospital ward, a box of sweets on a bedside table, pink ribbons

cards.name: Non-binary
cards.reveals: The form has two boxes. You'll have to insist.
cards.scene: a hospital office, a paper form with two boxes, a pen

events.bridge: The nurse writes it down. Somewhere, a map unfolds.

events.title: Where
events.setup: Somewhere on the map, a cot is waiting.
events.scene: an old paper world map unfolding on a wooden table, soft light

cards.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
cards.reveals: The youngest region on earth. Everyone is your age.
cards.scene: a cot in a small room with a tin roof
cards.place: sub-saharan africa, red earth, acacia trees, tin roofs, warm dusty light

cards.name: South Asia
cards.reveals: A fifth of humanity, and all of them have an opinion about your name.
cards.scene: a cot in a busy home, relatives crowding round
cards.place: south asia, crowded lanes, monsoon clouds, colourful walls

cards.name: East Asia
cards.reveals: A billion and a half people, very few of them siblings.
cards.scene: a cot in a quiet small apartment
cards.place: east asia, dense city blocks, apartment towers, neon signs

cards.name: Southeast Asia and the Pacific
cards.reveals: Thousands of islands. The nearest hospital is on another one.
cards.scene: a cot in a wooden stilt house by the sea, a boat outside
cards.place: southeast asia, tropical islands, palm trees, turquoise sea

cards.name: Middle East and North Africa
cards.reveals: Oil under the ground, history on top of it.
cards.scene: a cot in a sandstone house, oil derricks on the horizon
cards.place: middle east, desert, sandstone buildings, domes, golden light

cards.name: Latin America
cards.reveals: Between two oceans, and always between two currencies.
cards.scene: a cot in a painted house on a green hillside
cards.place: latin america, bright painted houses, green hills

cards.name: Europe
cards.reveals: Free healthcare, expensive everything else.
cards.scene: a cot in a tidy clinic, a nurse in a white uniform
cards.place: europe, old stone streets, tiled roofs, grey rainy sky

cards.name: North America
cards.reveals: The passport everyone else queues for.
cards.scene: a cot in a large suburban house, a passport on the table
cards.place: north america, wide suburbs, highways, big skies

events.bridge: The place is decided. Now, whose house.

events.title: Whom
events.setup: The household decides most of what comes next, and you don't get a vote.
events.scene: the front door of a home, seen from a cot

cards.name: Landless farmers
cards.reveals: Five children, one field, someone else's.
cards.scene: a mud house at the edge of a field, five children, a borrowed plough

cards.name: A shopkeeper's family
cards.reveals: You live above the shop and work in it by seven.
cards.scene: a small shop with a home above it, shelves of jars, a counter

cards.name: Salaried, on loans
cards.reveals: A loan for the flat, the car and the fridge.
cards.scene: a small apartment with a new fridge, a car parked outside, bills on the table

cards.name: Devout and strict
cards.reveals: Prayers before breakfast. Questions, never.
cards.scene: a modest home with a shrine, prayer books, morning light

cards.name: Artists, rent overdue
cards.reveals: Love, books, and a landlord at the door.
cards.scene: a cluttered flat full of books and paintings, a landlord at the door

cards.name: Old money
cards.reveals: Everything is paid for, including the silence.
cards.scene: a grand old mansion, high ceilings, portraits, a silent dining hall

cards.name: A politician's family
cards.reveals: Your birthday is a public event.
cards.scene: a large house with posters and garlands, a crowd at the gate, cameras

events.bridge: The house is ready. The body is still being decided.

events.title: Body
events.setup: The genes are dealt before you arrive. You may ask for a hand.
events.scene: inside the home, a cot by the window, soft morning light

cards.name: Average in every way
cards.reveals: The doctor writes "normal" and doesn't look up.

cards.name: Built like a wrestler
cards.reveals: You'll carry the suitcases at every wedding.

genes.label: A sturdy build
genes.words: a sturdy chubby build, strong little arms

cards.name: Your mother's eyes
cards.reveals: Everyone says so. Your father's side says it twice.

cards.name: A full head of hair
cards.reveals: The nurses take photos.

genes.label: A full head of hair
genes.words: a full head of thick black curly hair

cards.name: Quick with numbers
cards.reveals: You'll count everything, including who didn't visit.

cards.name: Green eyes from nowhere
cards.reveals: Nobody in the family has them. Nobody asks. Everyone wonders.

cards.name: Never ill a day
cards.reveals: The rarest gene there is.

cards.name: A birthmark shaped like a country
cards.reveals: The astrologer charges extra.

genes.label: A birthmark
genes.words: a small birthmark on the cheek

events.bridge: You learn to walk, then to wait. Eight years pass.

events.title: The school year
events.scene: a school classroom, rows of wooden desks, a blackboard

good.text: A teacher notices you and pins your drawing on the wall. She keeps it for years.
good.scene: a classroom wall with a child's drawing pinned on it, a kind teacher

bad.text: The family moves in the middle of the year. New school, new accent, nobody saves you a seat.
bad.scene: a new unfamiliar classroom, one empty desk at the back, moving boxes

neutral.text: A year passes. You learn long division and forget it by summer.
neutral.scene: a blackboard full of long division, summer light through the window

events.bridge: School, homework, school. Eight more years.

events.title: Education
events.setup: Choose a stream at sixteen, as if you knew who you'd be at forty.
events.scene: a school noticeboard with lists of names, a crowded corridor

cards.name: Arts
cards.reveals: There's always room. The relatives will ask what you'll do with it.
cards.scene: an art room with easels and old books

cards.name: Commerce
cards.reveals: Accounts, and a reasonable future.
cards.scene: a classroom with ledgers and calculators

cards.name: Science
cards.reveals: The default for anyone whose parents worry.
cards.scene: a science lab with test tubes and a periodic table

cards.name: Engineering
cards.reveals: Two years in a coaching town for a rank and a seat.
cards.scene: a coaching town, rows of billboards, students with heavy bags

cards.name: The medical seat
cards.reveals: One for the whole district.
cards.scene: a medical college hall, white coats, an anatomy skeleton

cards.name: Drop out, start a channel
cards.reveals: Four followers, all family.
cards.scene: a bedroom with a phone on a tripod and a ring light

events.bridge: Two years of studying for one week of exams.

events.title: The exams
events.scene: an exam hall, rows of desks, a big clock on the wall

good.text: The paper leaks. The exam is held again, and the retest is easier.
good.scene: an exam hall notice board: exam cancelled, retest

bad.text: You fall ill in exam week. You pass, barely, and the marksheet follows you for years.
bad.scene: a bed with medicine bottles, a marksheet on the table

neutral.text: You make a friend who will call only when they need something, for the next forty years.
neutral.scene: two friends outside an exam hall, a phone ringing

events.bridge: The marksheet is framed, or hidden. You're twenty, and someone asks what you want to be.

events.title: The dream
events.setup: Who do you dream of becoming?
events.scene: a rooftop at dusk, city lights below

cards.name: A doctor, as planned
cards.reveals: Everyone else's dream, now yours.
cards.scene: a hospital corridor, a white coat on a hook

cards.name: Rich, honestly
cards.reveals: No poetry about it.
cards.scene: a glass office tower, a shiny car

cards.name: Someone who leaves
cards.reveals: Anywhere but here.
cards.scene: an airport departures hall, a single suitcase

cards.name: An artist
cards.reveals: Poor, but interesting at dinner.
cards.scene: a small studio with canvases and a single lamp

cards.name: Someone people remember
cards.reveals: A statue, or at least a plaque.
cards.scene: a town square with an empty statue plinth

cards.name: Left alone
cards.reveals: The rarest thing on the list.
cards.scene: a quiet cabin in the hills, nobody around

events.bridge: You hold on to the dream for two years. Then the world does something.

events.title: The black swan
events.scene: a city street, a big news screen, people looking up

good.text: A technology nobody saw coming arrives. It happens to need exactly what you know.
good.scene: a bright new office full of strange new machines

bad.text: A pandemic closes the world for two years. Your plans wait in a drawer.
bad.scene: an empty city street, closed shutters, a mask on the pavement

neutral.text: The stock market crashes. You own no stocks.
neutral.scene: a stock market screen full of red numbers, people walking past

events.bridge: You need work. Work, it turns out, needs a coincidence.

events.title: The first job
events.scene: a cramped room, a laptop open to job listings

flukes.text: A stranger messages you online after misreading your profile. They like what they misread.
flukes.job: A job at a company you've never heard of.
flukes.scene: a small office with an unfamiliar logo on the door

flukes.text: Your old school teacher spots you at a tea stall. Her nephew needs someone.
flukes.job: A job at the nephew's firm.
flukes.scene: a family-run office, a tea stall outside

flukes.text: A wrong-number call. The caller was hiring.
flukes.job: A job taken over the phone before either of you noticed the mistake.
flukes.scene: an office desk with an old phone and a new employee badge

events.bridge: Four years at the job. Then one ordinary day.

events.title: Love
events.setup: One day. Somewhere in the city is the love of your life. You meet only if you end up in the same place.
events.scene: a city morning, crowds, many streets

miss.text: You didn't find love that day.
miss.scene: an empty bench in the evening, city lights

cards.name: A friend's wedding
cards.reveals: Everyone is single there, briefly.
cards.scene: a wedding party with string lights and flowers, two people talking

cards.name: The metro at rush hour
cards.reveals: Forty minutes pressed against strangers.
cards.scene: a crowded metro carriage, two people holding the same pole

cards.name: A dating app
cards.reveals: Four hundred matches, none of them where you are.
cards.scene: a cafe table for two, a phone glowing

cards.name: The library
cards.reveals: Very quiet. Nobody speaks to anyone.
cards.scene: a quiet library, two people reaching for the same book

cards.name: Stay home
cards.reveals: They'll have to come to you.
cards.scene: a doorstep, someone knocking with a wrong delivery

events.bridge: Five years pass. A phone call on a Tuesday.

events.title: The pivot
events.setup: A chance to change the direction of your life. It expires on Friday.
events.scene: an office desk with a ringing phone, a calendar showing Friday

cards.name: Change nothing
cards.reveals: The safest bet, and still a bet.
cards.scene: the same office desk, the same chair, nothing changed

cards.name: Move to the big city
cards.reveals: Smaller flat, bigger rent, better story.
cards.scene: a tiny flat in a huge city, skyscrapers outside the window

cards.name: A friend's business proposal
cards.reveals: He has a deck, and an uncle with money.
cards.scene: a small startup office, a pitch deck on a screen

cards.name: The offer abroad
cards.reveals: A new country, and a name nobody there can say.
cards.scene: a foreign city street, signs in another language

cards.name: Quit and start the thing
cards.reveals: The thing you've described at every party for ten years.
cards.scene: a garage workshop with a hand-painted sign

events.bridge: You live with the choice for three years.

events.title: The years after
events.scene: an office floor, the same routine every day

good.text: A senior colleague retires early. Their work, and their office, become yours.
good.scene: a corner office with a window, a nameplate being changed

bad.text: Your company is sold. Your role is "under review" for three years.
bad.scene: an office full of boxes, a sign: under new management

neutral.text: You get a new chair. You talk about it for a week.
neutral.scene: an office with a shiny new chair

events.bridge: The relatives start asking at every wedding.

events.title: Marriage
events.setup: Who do you want to spend your life with?
events.scene: a wedding hall full of relatives and garlands

cards.name: Whoever the family finds
cards.reveals: There is already a shortlist.
cards.scene: a living room, two families sitting across from each other, tea and sweets

cards.name: Someone from the same background
cards.reveals: The relatives approve before they meet them.
cards.scene: a traditional wedding, relatives nodding

cards.name: No one: marry your work
cards.reveals: Your laptop never forgets an anniversary.
cards.scene: a desk at night, a laptop glowing, a cake for one

cards.name: Someone who makes you laugh
cards.reveals: Funny at dinner, funny at 3 a.m.
cards.scene: a small kitchen at night, two people laughing

cards.name: Someone rich
cards.reveals: Love can come later. It has a budget.
cards.scene: a lavish wedding with chandeliers

cards.name: Someone who lets you be
cards.reveals: Rarer than rich.
cards.scene: a quiet garden, two chairs side by side, each person reading

events.bridge: Four years in, the house finds its routine.

events.title: Settling down
events.scene: a family home in the evening, a dinner table

good.text: The relatives move to another city.
good.scene: a quiet house, a moving truck driving away

bad.scene: a crowded house, suitcases in the hallway, extra beds

neutral.text: Life settles into a routine so steady you stop noticing the years.
neutral.scene: a calendar on the wall, a steady clock, the same days

events.bridge: Eight quiet years. Too quiet.

events.title: The buried layer
events.setup: Something true about your life has been hidden all along. Now it comes out. Choose which.
events.scene: an old box of papers opened on a table, dust in the light

cards.name: A financial scam
cards.reveals: The savings were never there.
cards.scene: an empty bank vault, papers scattered

cards.name: A rare disease
cards.reveals: Slow, and manageable, with a name nobody can pronounce.
cards.scene: a doctor's office, a long word on a chart

cards.name: Swapped at birth
cards.reveals: Your real family lives two streets away.
cards.scene: two houses two streets apart, a family at the window

cards.name: The degree
cards.reveals: Your university never existed.
cards.scene: an empty lot where a university should be

cards.name: A half-sibling
cards.reveals: They're at the door, with your nose.
cards.scene: a doorway, a stranger with a familiar face

cards.name: A small debt
cards.reveals: Your father owed a neighbour 400 rupees.
cards.scene: a neighbour's door, a small envelope of money

cards.name: Nothing
cards.reveals: There was no secret.
cards.scene: an empty box, nothing inside

events.bridge: You learn to live with it. One evening, it rains.

events.title: The umbrella
events.text: On a rainy evening, you lend your umbrella to a stranger at a bus stop. You never see it again.
events.scene: a rainy bus stop at night, a stranger walking off under an umbrella
events.bridge: Eight more years. The office orders a cake.

events.title: Retirement
events.setup: The office gives you a cake and a shawl. What will you mostly do now?
events.scene: an office party, a cake and a folded shawl

cards.name: Mind the grandchildren
cards.reveals: Unpaid, full-time, no leave.
cards.scene: a living room full of toys and small children

cards.name: Go back to where you were born
cards.reveals: It's a mall now.
cards.scene: a shopping mall where an old house used to be

cards.name: Write the memoir
cards.reveals: Chapter one is 200 pages.
cards.scene: a desk with a huge stack of handwritten pages

cards.name: See the world
cards.reveals: Seven countries in twelve days, on a bus.
cards.scene: a tour bus in front of a famous monument

cards.name: Start a business, at last
cards.reveals: Your children are investors, reluctantly.
cards.scene: a small new shop, a ribbon being cut

cards.name: Forward messages to everyone you know
cards.reveals: Good morning, with a sunflower.
cards.scene: a phone screen full of good morning messages with sunflowers

events.bridge: Four years into the rest of it, something comes back.

events.title: The umbrella comes back
events.scene: a rainy street, a black umbrella

good.text: The stranger became a minister. He remembers the umbrella. Your pension file moves to the top of the pile.
good.scene: a government office, a file moving to the top of a pile

bad.text: The umbrella, your name sewn inside, turns up as evidence in someone else's court case. You spend a year explaining you only lent it.
bad.scene: a courtroom, an umbrella in an evidence bag

neutral.text: You see the same umbrella in a shop window, for sale. You don't buy it back.
neutral.scene: a shop window with an umbrella for sale

events.bridge: The years get shorter. Then there is one left.

events.title: Death
events.setup: You get to choose how you go. Mostly.
events.scene: a quiet room, evening light, an empty chair by a window

cards.name: Of something with a long name
cards.reveals: The doctors are excited. You are less so.
cards.scene: a hospital room, doctors gathered round a chart

cards.name: On the day the pension arrives
cards.reveals: The money clears. You don't.
cards.scene: a bank counter, a pension slip

cards.name: Laughing at your own joke
cards.reveals: Nobody else laughed.
cards.scene: a dinner table, one chair pushed back

cards.name: Mid-sentence, finally winning an argument
cards.reveals: The last word was yours. Half of it.
cards.scene: a living room, an argument left unfinished

cards.name: In your sleep, at 94
cards.reveals: Everyone's first choice.
cards.scene: a bedroom at dawn, a peaceful bed

cards.name: A laddoo at a wedding
cards.reveals: Very festive.
cards.scene: a wedding feast, a plate of sweets

events.bridge: That was a life.
